g.text: 13 of 275 packages differ on unstable; kernel 7.2.12 → 7.2.13, latest 7.3; 5 not on search.nixos.org
search.nixos.org has many attributes per pname; the one defined in the same file as the installed package is compared
(else the same major version, then the attribute named like the pname). `nixin outdated` without --published is exact.
